newsitem.title: UK: Michael Jackson house-hunting in Scotland -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Michael Jackson house-hunting in Scotland -- paper.

text.p: Superstar Michael Jackson has been house-hunting in Scotland, a Scottish newspaper reported on Sunday.
"I love it here. I want to make this my home," the Sunday Mail quoted the U.S. pop idol as saying. "The country is beautiful and the people are beautiful."
It quoted a member of Jackson's entourage as saying the star had looked around at least one property -- Glenmayne House, near the town of Galashiels midway between Edinburgh and the English border.
The mansion, set in 14 acres (5.8 hectares) of grounds, is on the market for 550,000 pounds ($925,000).

The newspaper said Jackson, wearing a black wide-brimmed hat, red jacket and a scarf covering most of his face, spent Friday visiting Stirling Castle in central Scotland and stopped at the town's McDonald's burger restaurant for a meal.
A spokesman for the Cameron House Hotel on the banks of Loch Lomond confirmed that Jackson had spent Friday night there in a luxury suite.
"It was a surprise to us all here," he said. "We genuinely didn't know it would be Michael Jackson, we were just told it was a VIP."
